title: Our Place
description: Jacob Willett's first project, made in his first semester of SDSU's film program. He pitched and developed the idea, then brought in writers Amanda Harper and Wren Jordan before directing. A devious romance emerges in the midst of a tragic breakup — a queer anti-romance starring Jordan Davenport, Angel Huerta, and Lucien Escarguel, inspired by John Waters and Divine's "Female Trouble." Winner, Best Original Song at the San Diego Short Film Festival's Q3 showcase. Scored with a fully custom-composed piece for live brass, organ, piano, and clarinet — the lead actress came into the studio to record vocals over it.
